name: Webflow
summary: Visual web builder. Blue-accented, polished marketing site aesthetic
description: An inspired interpretation of Webflow's design language — a visual web development platform whose surface contrasts a deep near-black `#080808` primary against a generous white canvas, broken by a five-stop chromatic accent system (purple / pink / blue / orange / green) that maps to the brand's product categories, and anchored by the proprietary WF Visual Sans family used at restrained 500 / 600 weights with negative tracking.

colors.name: Ink Black
colors.role: The brand's primary conversion colour. Every primary CTA, every heading, every wordmark. Deeper than pure black to read as branded.

colors.name: Accent Purple
colors.role: One of the five chromatic category accents — used for design / build product surfaces.

colors.name: Accent Pink
colors.role: Magenta accent — used for animation / interaction product surfaces.

colors.name: Accent Blue
colors.role: Bright cyan-blue — used for SEO / analytics product surfaces.

colors.name: Accent Blue Deep
colors.role: The deeper blue used for emphasis links.

colors.name: Accent Orange
colors.role: Used for hosting / infrastructure product surfaces.

colors.name: Accent Yellow
colors.role: Used for warning / collaboration product surfaces.

colors.name: Hairline
colors.role: 1 px solid borders — input borders, card chrome, divider lines.

colors.name: Body Mid
colors.role: Mid-emphasis secondary text — footer lines, captions.

colors.name: Mute Soft
colors.role: The lightest text role — placeholder text, fine print.

substitutesNote:
WF Visual Sans Variable is proprietary. Open-source substitutes:
- **Display + body** — *Inter* weights 400 / 500 / 600 with `font-feature-settings: "ss01"` enabled is the closest stylistic match.
- **Mono** — *Inconsolata* (the documented fallback) or *DM Mono*.
